ko: [Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]자꾸 이상한 거 먹으면 안 돼, 케오……
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]좋은 말로 할 때 그만 해!
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]이름 없는 깃발이라, 과연 무엇을 의미하는 걸까?
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]음, 조금 무거운데. 악당을 때리면, 엄청 아프겠다!
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=1)]뭐지, 이 쇠망치의 녹이 전부 모래가 돼서 벗겨졌네?!
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]이게 바로 내가 그토록 추구하던 무기 영혼과의 공명인가!
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]그런데, 이 망치가 자꾸 이상한 소리를 해. 케오는 못 알아듣겠어.
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=1)]설마, 정말 그 조직이랑 관련된 건가……
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]뭐, 됐다. 케오, 일단 망치를 챙기고 출발하자.
en: [Title] MAIN_LOG_103_1
[Div] Part.02
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=1)]There goes the last of the snacks I keep in reserve...
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]No more eating anything weird, Kay.
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]Thanks, Dur-nar! I'm full now!
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]Then perhaps I too should—
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]Don't push your luck!
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=1)]*sigh*... So, back to this hammer.
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]See this pennant on the handle?
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]Don't you guys think it looks like a flag?
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]An anonymous flag? Just what does it stand for?
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=1)]I can hear it saying stuff!
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]Like my other weapons!
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]I'm gonna keep it. Hup!
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]Whoa, kinda heavy. Really gonna hurt for the bad guys!
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=1)]All the rust just fell off?! Like it turned into sand!
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]Is that your Arts, Kay?
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]Harmonization with weapons! It's the Soul Resonance I've been forever seeking!
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]No, it's Arts! Originium Arts!
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]This hammer speaks really weird. I don't get it.
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]What is it 'saying'?
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]Annihilate all nomadic cities!
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=1)]You can't be serious. Is it connected to THEM? That's a little on-the-nose, isn't it?
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]Whatever. You hold onto it for now, Kay. Let's move.
ja: [Title] MAIN_LOG_103_1
[Div] Part.02
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=1)]はい、これあげるから。私が隠してた最後のおやつよ……
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]何でも口に入れるのはやめてね、ケーちゃん。
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]ありがとうジュナーお姉ちゃん！　おいらお腹いっぱいになった！
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]じゃあ俺にも……
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]いい加減にして！
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=1)]はぁ……それでこのハンマーだけど。
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]持ち手に付いてる帯を見てみて。
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]なんだか、旗に見えない？
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]名前の書かれていない旗に、一体どんな意味があるんだ？
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=1)]この子の声が聞こえるよ！
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]おいらのほかの武器とおんなじだ！
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]だったらおいらが持ってってあげるよ……よいしょ。
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]うぅ、ちょっと重いや。でもこれで悪い奴をぶん殴ったらすっごく痛いはずだよ！
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=1)]ハンマーの錆が、砂になって落ちた！？
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]これがケーちゃんのアーツなの？
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]いいや、これこそが俺がずっと求めていた現象――武器の魂との共鳴だ！
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]ただのアーツよ！
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]このハンマーの言葉は変だよ。おいら、こいつの言ってる意味がわかんないや。
[Dialog(head="char_379_sesa", delay=0.5)]こいつは何て「言った」んだ？
[Dialog(head="char_2013_cerber", delay=0.5)]すべての移動都市を滅ぼす──だって！
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=1)]まさか本当にあの組織と関係が……？
[Dialog(head="char_260_durnar", delay=0.5)]いいわ、そろそろ出発にしましょうか。ケーちゃん、しばらくそれを持っててくれるかしら。
